title: ticfac checkpoint never settles gms: state says 'integrated' while the tracker closed it and every sibling row says 'closed'
body: In .ticfac/runs/epic-pwp/checkpoint.json every other pwp tick reads 'closed' (azq, nkf, 3r2, sx5, hvj, os6) but gms still reads 'integrated' (attempt 8) even though its findings were promoted and .tick closed the tick hours before the run ended. Whatever the intended semantics of the per-tick state, one row silently diverging from both its siblings and the tracker of record is drift a closeout has to notice by eye. Either re-settle a tick's checkpoint row when its findings are triaged, or state why 'integrated' is terminal for it.
